Construct Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix from Ratings Vector

Source: R/simulations.R
getPRMFromRatings.Rd

Reconstructs an n x n Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix (PRM) from an upper-triangular pairwise ratings vector V of length n(n-1)/2.

Usage

getPRMFromRatings(V, n = (1 + sqrt(1 + 8 * length(V)))/2)

Arguments

V

Numeric vector containing upper-triangular pairwise comparison ratings of length n(n-1)/2.

n

Numeric scalar representing the dimension of the square PRM. Calculated automatically from the length of V by solving n(n-1)/2 = length(V).

Value

A numeric square matrix of dimension n x n representing the Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix (PRM), or NA_real_ with a warning if the input vector length is invalid.

References

Yuen, K. K. F. (2024). Inverse Gram Matrix Methods for Prioritization in Analytic Hierarchy Process: Explainability of Weighted Least Squares Optimization Method. arXiv preprint arXiv:2401.01190. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2401.01190

Author

Kevin Kam Fung Yuen

Examples

# Vector of 3 upper-triangular ratings for a 3x3 matrix
V <- c(2, 5, 3)
A <- getPRMFromRatings(V)
print(A)
#>      [,1]      [,2] [,3]
#> [1,]  1.0 2.0000000    5
#> [2,]  0.5 1.0000000    3
#> [3,]  0.2 0.3333333    1
